user_message.content: Walk me through creating the Google Apps Script code for my new sheet step-by-step.

status_update.description: Manus is working on your request

assistant_message.content:
Follow these steps in the **new Google Sheet you own**.

### 1. Create and name the sheet

Create a blank spreadsheet at [Google Sheets](https://sheets.new) and name it:

> **12518 Sunset Blvd. — Open House RSVPs**

Leave the first tab name as-is, or rename it `RSVPs`.

### 2. Open Apps Script

In the spreadsheet menu, select **Extensions → Apps Script**. A new browser tab opens with a code editor.

### 3. Replace the starter code

Click in the editor, select all existing code, delete it, and paste this:

```javascript
const WEBHOOK_TOKEN = 'REPLACE_THIS_WITH_A_LONG_PRIVATE_RANDOM_TOKEN';

function doPost(e) {
  try {
    const data = JSON.parse(e.postData.contents || '{}');

    if (data.token !== WEBHOOK_TOKEN) {
      return ContentService
        .createTextOutput(JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: 'Unauthorized' }))
        .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
    }

    const spreadsheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
    const sheet = spreadsheet.getSheetByName('RSVPs') || spreadsheet.insertSheet('RSVPs');

    if (sheet.getLastRow() === 0) {
      sheet.appendRow(['Name', 'Phone Number', 'Guests', 'Submitted At']);
      sheet.getRange('A1:D1').setFontWeight('bold');
      sheet.setFrozenRows(1);
    }

    sheet.appendRow([
      data.name || '',
      data.phone || '',
      data.guestCount || '',
      data.submittedAt || new Date().toISOString()
    ]);

    return ContentService
      .createTextOutput(JSON.stringify({ ok: true }))
      .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
  } catch (error) {
    return ContentService
      .createTextOutput(JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: String(error) }))
      .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
  }
}
```

### 4. Set the private token

Replace this exact text:

```text
REPLACE_THIS_WITH_A_LONG_PRIVATE_RANDOM_TOKEN
```

with a private, hard-to-guess secret. For example, make up a long phrase with numbers and punctuation. Do **not** share it publicly.

### 5. Save the script

Click the **Save** icon near the top left. If prompted, name the project:

> **Sunset Open House RSVP Webhook**

### 6. Deploy it as a web app

Click **Deploy → New deployment**.

In the popup:

1. Click the gear icon next to **Select type**.
2. Select **Web app**.
3. Enter `Sunset RSVP webhook` as the description.
4. Set **Execute as** to **Me**.
5. Set **Who has access** to **Anyone**.
6. Click **Deploy**.

Google will request permission to manage this sheet. Complete the authorization flow. You may need to click **Advanced** and then choose the option to proceed to your script because it is your own unpublished script.

### 7. Copy the deployed URL

After deployment, Google displays a **Web app URL**. Copy the URL ending in:

```text
/exec
```

### 8. Share the sheet with Shelene

Back in the spreadsheet, click **Share**, enter Shelene’s email, and choose **Viewer** if she only needs to see RSVPs or **Editor** if she will manage the list.

### 9. Send me two private values

Send me the following in this chat so I can connect and test the RSVP form:

| Item | What it looks like |
|---|---|
| Web App URL | `https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec` |
| Private token | The secret you set in Step 4 |

Keep both values out of Partiful and any public invitation. Once you send them, I will connect the form and submit one clearly labeled test RSVP so you can see it arrive in the new sheet.
